notablePrerequisites:
Mirror Image on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Mirror Image do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Mirror Image.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Mirror Image.
Activate Mirror Image by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Mirror Image ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
